events.text: {npc} has waited up for you with tea, as {he} does most nights. Tonight {he} wants to talk about something other than the murim.

effects.log: You talk until the candle burns out: about the garden, about the neighbours, about nothing at all. It is the best evening of the year.
{npc} nods and pours the tea out into the garden. You train. It is not the same.

events.text: {npc} cleans the blood off your sleeve without a word. Then, very quietly: "One day you won't come home. What happens to us then?"

effects.log: "You always say that." But {he} holds your hand a little longer than usual.
Every evening for a season, in the courtyard. By spring {npc} can throw you. Nobody mentions that part.

events.text: It is the anniversary of your wedding. You almost forgot. {npc} did not.

choices.text: Take {him} back to where you married

effects.log: The same place, older now, and so are you. {He} laughs the same way {he} did that day.

ok.log: You produce a hastily bought gift with great confidence. It works, mostly.

fail.log: {npc} sees straight through you. The house is very quiet for a week.

events.text: The household accounts do not add up, and {npc} has found out why: your silver keeps going to swords and pills.

effects.log: Within a year the house has savings. You are not sure how. You are not allowed to ask.

mem.note: chose the sword over the house

effects.log: True, perhaps. {npc} is not convinced, and says so for a month.
